mapper.select: SELECT imm.item_id as itemId, imm.item_name as itemName, bmm.quantity, imm.unit, SUM(COALESCE(sk.stock_qty,0)) as stockQuantity, SUM(COALESCE(sk.defective_qty,0)) as defectiveQuantity, SUM(COALESCE(sk.hold_qty,0)) as holdQuantity FROM bom_master bmm INNER JOIN item_master imm ON bmm.child_id = imm.item_id LEFT JOIN stock sk ON imm.item_id = sk.item_id WHERE bmm.parent_id = #{itemId} GROUP BY imm.item_id, imm.item_name, bmm.quantity, imm.unit

SELECT bmm.parent_id as parentId, imm.item_id as itemId, imm.item_name as itemName, bmm.quantity, imm.unit, SUM(COALESCE(sk.stock_qty,0)) as stockQuantity, SUM(COALESCE(sk.defective_qty,0)) as defectiveQuantity, SUM(COALESCE(sk.hold_qty,0)) as holdQuantity FROM bom_master bmm INNER JOIN item_master imm ON bmm.child_id = imm.item_id LEFT JOIN stock sk ON imm.item_id = sk.item_id GROUP BY bmm.parent_id, imm.item_id, imm.item_name, bmm.quantity, imm.unit
